speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I need a formal sign off on the shadow environment before any model touches live traffic. We cannot accept a partial review when a bad forecast will hit every store order window.
output.correction: I am talking about the governance of the deployment gate, not the automation of the monitoring tools. You filed this as a tooling request, but I am asking for a strict human approval process.
